items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: She wanted to throw it at Buster, her piano player.

ctx.x: Oh you heard of it. That was enough. I don't want to see any of that job.

Well part of that was in the movie where she threw the gin on this promoter. Yeah. Actually that was me she threw the gin on. Oh I see. She wanted to throw it at Buster, her piano player. And I walk in the door at the time, she splashed when I was in Club Nemo in Detroit.
And his name was Buster, huh? Yeah.
